phase1_leaf_result.part92_scope: Official GitHub current repository REST metadata plus rename, transfer, and deleted-repository restoration documentation only.
phase1_leaf_result.new_positive_evidence: Current REST metadata exposes a provider-assigned repository id/node_id that is useful as a current-incarnation identifier.
phase1_leaf_result.new_falsification: Current non-mutating repository metadata does not expose predecessor identity/incarnation history; logical-name reuse can break rename/transfer redirects, and deleted-repository restoration is bounded to 90 days. Therefore current metadata alone cannot prove a stateless monotonic incarnation lower bound after predecessor loss.
phase1_leaf_result.minimal_unresolved_child: A provider-side monotonic predecessor/incarnation witness that remains discoverable after logical-name reuse and predecessor deletion/restore expiry without retaining predecessor identity, paid/finite quota, mutation, or external storage.

phase1_acceptance.scope_guard: Documented/current GitHub repository identity and rename/transfer/restore route only; no claim about undocumented/internal/future provider metadata.
